raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: znh5md
  version: "0.4.8"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/znh5md-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9dd02d45b5ed766e2f6a0c5b8c926cd15e5a8b9c3a80cab0303f518b129f16ac

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - znh5md = znh5md.cli:app

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling
    - pip
  run:
    - plams >=2025.102
    - python >=${{ python_min }},<4.0.0
    - h5py >=3.12.1
    - ase >=3.24.0
    - tqdm >=4.67.1
    - typer >=0.15.1

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - znh5md
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - znh5md --help

about:
  summary: ASE Interface for the H5MD format.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/zincware/ZnH5MD

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
